about_the_game:
Star Ores Inc. – The Official Book

Want to learn more about Star Ores Inc., its characters, and the long-forgotten station? Then you’re in the right place!

This official companion book includes:

The Station’s Backstory

Written by Ben Calvin Hary (currently lead writer at PERRY RHODAN, among others).

Discover who originally built the station, why it drifted abandoned through space for 350 years — and what all of that does to the sensitive emotion chips of a little robot named B.O.B.I.

“Entrepreneur’s Station Handout”

The unofficial but highly practical quick-start guide for all newly minted station operators!

Everything you need to know about the modern (well… 350-year-old) facilities, amenities, and automated support bots (like B.O.B.I.s and F3000-I ore units — aka Erfis).

A must-read for anyone curious about what actually works on their shiny-almost-new station — and what only runs on sheer optimism.

(Be honest: it was cheap, and you couldn’t afford anything better anyway.)

Morey Millers Mining & Processing Product Portfolio

(Formerly known as the Morey Millers Mining & Processing Product Catalog — but hey, marketing needs to justify its salary somehow.)

The must-have reference for anyone who wants to dig deeper — literally.

From the Deep Core Drill Mk IV to the latest Smelt-O-Tron models and automated forge cores, this guide has everything a prospector could dream of.

Perfect for turning your mine into a thriving business — or at least impressing the Trader’s Guild with your contributions.

Experience the world of Star Ores Inc. like never before — with backstories, in-universe manuals, and plenty of tongue-in-cheek commentary.

Perfect for fans, collectors, and anyone curious about what really lurks beneath the surface.
